replies.author: SirCyaniide
replies.body:
Hey slick!

A couple of players vouched that this punishment was invalid. Considering the evidence is misleading, I will take the incentive of removing this ban. Next time, please refrain from breaking any blocks while others are on them, or walking towards them. You will be appealed, I apologize for the inconvenience. Enjoy your time on Avicus!

Also, if you're not familiar with the rules, click on the link here to check them out!

Regards, Avicus Moderator 

SirCyanide
